0.text: This is Gérald Genta, one of the most celebrated watch designers in history. Let's go back to the night that made his name.

1.text: Nineteen seventy. Audemars Piguet needs a watch the world has never seen.

2.text: One afternoon, Georges Golay calls designer Gérald Genta. A steel watch, unlike any before. By morning.

3.text: Overnight, Genta thinks of a diver's helmet: a porthole, bolted shut.

4.text: It becomes an octagon. Eight screws in plain sight. A bracelet flowing from the case. All in steel.

5.text: Steel was for tool watches. This one was finished like a precious watch, and cost more than many gold ones.

6.text: Basel, nineteen seventy-two. The Royal Oak, reference fifty-four oh two. Thirty-nine millimetres, huge for its time.

7.text: Many doubted it. Time proved them wrong. A sketch overnight. An icon for generations.
